privacy.title: {name} Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Welcome to {name} (the “Bot”). We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. Please read this Privacy Policy carefully to understand how we collect, use, and protect your information.

collection.heading: 1. Information We Collect
collection.intro: The Bot may collect the following types of information:
collection.server_text: When you use the Bot in a Discord server, we may collect the server ID, channel IDs, and related usage data.
collection.interaction_text: We may record your interactions with the Bot, such as command usage and response content, to improve service quality.
collection.technical_text: We may collect technical information about your device, such as your IP address, browser type, and operating system, to help diagnose problems and improve your experience.
collection.logs_text: We automatically collect certain log data, such as error reports and usage statistics, so that we can analyze and improve the Bot.
collection.user_text: We collect user IDs for identification and service delivery.
collection.excluded_intro: The Bot does not collect the following type of information:
collection.message_text: We do not collect or store the content of your Discord messages. The Bot only processes a message when another user applies a Bot feature to that message.

use.heading: 2. How We Use Information
use.intro: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
use.service: To provide and maintain the Bot's features and services.
use.analytics: To analyze usage trends and improve the Bot's performance and user experience.
use.support: To respond to user questions and support requests.

protection.heading: 3. Information Security
protection.body: We use appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, or destruction. However, please note that no method of transmission or electronic storage is completely secure.

sharing.heading: 4. Information Sharing
sharing.body: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. We may, however, share your information in the following situation:
sharing.legal: Legal requirements: We may disclose your information when required by law or when necessary to protect our rights.

contact.heading: 5. Deletion Requests and Contact
contact.body: Although the Bot generally does not store users' message content or personal data, if you have concerns about your data privacy or want to exercise your right to request deletion (including confirming whether we hold your data), please contact us through one of the following methods:
contact.final: After receiving your request, we will help verify and handle the relevant matter.

terms.title: {name} Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to {name} (the “Bot”). By using the Bot, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service:

service.heading: 1. Service
service.body: The Bot provides various features designed to improve interaction and management efficiency in Discord servers. Specific features may change over time.

rules.heading: 2. Acceptable Use
rules.discord: You must comply with Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.
rules.age: You may not use the Bot if you are under 13 years old, or under the minimum age required by law where you live.
rules.legal: You agree not to use the Bot for unlawful activity or conduct that violates Discord's Community Guidelines.
rules.interference: You may not attempt to interfere with or disrupt the Bot's normal operation.
rules.privacy: You must respect other users' privacy and rights and may not use the Bot to collect or distribute another person's personal information.

liability.heading: 3. Limitation of Liability
liability.body: The Bot is provided “as is.” The developer is not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the Bot.

changes.heading: 4. Service Changes and Termination
changes.body: The developer reserves the right to modify or terminate the Bot at any time without prior notice.

revisions.heading: 5. Changes to These Terms
revisions.body: The developer reserves the right to modify these Terms of Service at any time. Revised terms will be published on this page. You should review this page periodically for the latest Terms of Service.

contact.heading: 6. Contact
contact.body: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, contact the developer on Discord: @{owner}.

index.about_desc: A hand-written multi-purpose Discord bot with over 40 modules covering server moderation, automation, an economy system, music playback, minigames, AI chat, and more. Whether you want a safe, orderly community or a server full of fun, this bot has you covered. It is, of course, a giant pile of spaghetti code.

feature.ai_desc: Free AI models with multi-turn conversations and contextual memory — your intelligent assistant.
feature.dsize_desc: Measure with friends, battle for the longest, or even feed them grass.
feature.economy_desc: Dual currencies (global + server), daily rewards, shops, transfers, exchange rates, and an inflation model.
feature.games_desc: Big Two, tower climbing, Akinator, DOOM, plus dsize battles and PetPet GIFs.
feature.moderation_desc: Kick, ban, mute, and blacklist tools with bulk actions plus automated anti-spam / anti-raid protection.
feature.music_desc: High-quality playback via Lavalink with queues, looping, shuffle, recommendations, and multi-node failover.
feature.panel_desc: Log in with Discord OAuth2 and configure your server from the web — what you see is what you get.
feature.quake_desc: Integrates OXWU and the CWA for instant earthquake early warnings and reports pushed to your channel.
feature.twbus_desc: Real-time Taiwan bus arrivals and YouBike station status — a commuter's best friend.
feature.webverify_desc: reCAPTCHA / Turnstile web verification that keeps bot accounts and raids out.
